## Details

<a id="pose_ptrs"></a>
### [`pose_ptrs`](../../../../src/fighter/poses.asm#L6) `$BC16-$BCCB`

*data*

Pointers to the pose records of poses $00-$5a. The pose number is in $6f,x.

- **Read by:** [`animate_fighter`](animate.md#animate_fighter), [`draw_fighter_sprites`](../sprites/fighter_sprites.md#draw_fighter_sprites)

<a id="pose_00"></a>
### [`pose_00`](../../../../src/fighter/poses.asm#L31) `$BCCC-$BCDB`

*data*

Pose record: 9 sprite part numbers (3 x 3 grid), move flags, step size, sprite count. Part n is at $0800+64n, 0 is empty. Move flag bits 3 and 4 move the fighter by the step size. 4 bytes follow for each sprite. Sprite bytes: pointer minus $20, colour (bit 7 set: multicolour, else fighter_colours), Y position, X offset.

- **Entry of:** [`pose_ptrs`](../../tables.md#pose_ptrs)
